Overview

Ptuj is a city in Ptuj with a population of 18,000. Slovenia’s oldest recorded city, a charming town on the Drava River with a stunning castle, a historic old town, and the famous Kurentovanje carnival festival. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
